decisions.reason: The manual laser marking workstation costs little to keep alongside the firm's laser line, but it has only ever been mentioned on the website and the new LC400 cabin may overlap with it, so its value is still uncertain rather than proven.
The thermal inkjet printer has had its own page for two years and sits in the firm's core coding and marking business, so keeping it costs little and there is no evidence of failure.
The piezo inkjet printer has kept its own page for two years and complements the thermal inkjet line, so it remains a cheap option worth holding while demand becomes clear.
Placement on the home page shows a strong commitment to the industrial laser marking systems, and the option is too new to judge, so further investment is justified.
The LC400 cabin was just launched and is actively promoted, so its uncertainty has not resolved and abandoning it now would waste the option.
The Blechexpo award is an early positive signal for this niche lubricant printing system, which makes it worth keeping despite its modest website presence.
